metadata.description: Every plugin in the IU research skills family: research computing, research data, research funding, research cores, and the shared parent.

plugins.name: iu-research
plugins.description: The shared parent of the IU research skills family: report a problem with any family skill to the repository that owns it.

plugins.name: research-technologies
plugins.description: Skills for IU research computing: access checks, system selection, allocations, Slurm jobs, data storage and transfer, Jetstream2, and getting help.

plugins.name: research-data
plugins.description: Skills for research data at IU: find data IU already has, classify it, plan management and sharing, and stay within IU policy and sponsor rules.

plugins.name: research-funding
plugins.description: Skills for planning and preparing grant proposals at IU: find opportunities, write Specific Aims and the Research Strategy, budget, route, and resubmit.

plugins.name: research-cores
plugins.description: Skills for IU research core facilities: match research to a core, budget and acknowledge core work, and handle instrument data.
